# Turn Someday Into Day One

> A private recovery companion for people breaking a habit they've fought for years,
> plus a section built for the partner who is living alongside it. Built and run by one
> person, Jacques, who was addicted for 38 years and got to day one at 50. Covers 13
> tracks: porn and sex, alcohol, smoking, substances, gambling, social media, gaming,
> food and binging, shopping and spending, work, anger and control, supporting someone
> you love, and a general track. Written for everybody — straight, gay, bi, men and
> women.

Core recovery tools are free with no card: the day counter, the daily check-in, the
first lesson pack, a relapse plan with a panic button, and basic access to the AI
companion (Friendly, 3 chats a day). Pro adds all 13 lesson packs, 30 Friendly chats a
day, and the full partner section.

This site does not diagnose anyone, does not sell a cure, and does not claim clinical
authority. Pages about a partner's drinking or porn use are written to help the reader
decide what to do next, not to label the person they love.

## Start here

- [Home](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/): what the app is and who built it
- [The 2-minute check-in](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/quiz): free, no signup, the usual first step
- [The app](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/app): the product itself
- [Privacy policy](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/privacy): what is stored and what is not

## For the person in it

- [How to stop drinking](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/how-to-stop-drinking)
- [Hangxiety](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/hangxiety): the anxiety the morning after drinking — what it is, how long it lasts, what helps
- [How to stop binge eating](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/how-to-stop-binge-eating)
- [What is a dry drunk?](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/dry-drunk): sober and still the same person — why stopping wasn't the finished job
- [The 90-day brain reset](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/brainreset)

## For the partner

- [For her](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/for-her): the section written for the person alongside it
- [When he drinks](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/when-he-drinks)
- [Is my husband an alcoholic?](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/is-my-husband-an-alcoholic): refuses to diagnose, helps you decide what to do
- [When your partner drinks](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/partner-drinks)
- [When your partner watches porn](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/partner-watches-porn)
- [Betrayal trauma recovery](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/betrayal-trauma-recovery)
- [Codependency](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/codependency): what it means, the signs, and how to stop — refuses to treat it as a diagnosis
- [Codependency test](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/codependency-test): a free 8-question check-in, scored on the device, nothing stored
- [Adult children of alcoholics](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/adult-children-of-alcoholics): the traits, and what to do with them; links out to adultchildren.org, not affiliated
- [The "alcoholic personality"](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/alcoholic-personality): what the behaviors are doing, and why they are not who somebody is
- [What is Al-Anon?](https://www.turnsomedayintodayone.com/what-is-al-anon): a plain explainer that sends people on to al-anon.org; not affiliated with Al-Anon Family Groups
